title: Shopify customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate requires a payment method identifier as of 2026-07
summary: As of Admin API version 2026-07, customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate requires the gateway's payment method identifier: paymentMethodId for Stripe, customerPaymentProfileId for Authorize.net, paymentMethodToken for Braintree.
migrationNote: Send the gateway's payment method identifier with every customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate call before moving to 2026-07.
